title: GIFT-seq: Nuclei Preparation
author: Karolis Kumpaitis
materials: While sorting prepare buffers (Quantities for 1 sample): 1.5 mL 10x Genomics Quenching Buffer B (Step 2.8) or 1.5 mL S&C Buffer. 1 mL PBS-T. Thaw aliquots 500 µL 162 nM 2-amino-5-methylbenzoic acid in PBS. 20 µL 40 µg/mL Proteinase K in PBS (1:500 Stock dilution).

While sorting prepare buffers (Quantities for 1 sample): 1.5 mL 10x Genomics Quenching Buffer B (Step 2.8) or 1.5 mL S&C Buffer. 1 mL PBS-T. Thaw aliquots 500 µL 162 nM 2-amino-5-methylbenzoic acid in PBS. 20 µL 40 µg/mL Proteinase K in PBS (1:500 Stock dilution).

steps.title: Collect FFPE tissue curls
steps.instruction: Obtain 2–6 FFPE curls per sample, each 50–80 µm thick; store curls in a 1.5 mL tube at 4 °C for long‑term storage.

steps.title: Pre‑cool NIC+ cartridges
steps.instruction: Pre‑cool two yellow NIC+ cartridges (S2 Genomics) at 4 °C or on ice. Turn on the Singulator tablet and start the FFPE protocol, allowing the machine to pre‑heat for 10 min (00:10:00). If a temperature‑not‑reached pop‑up appears, press “Wait”. During the run, pre‑cool the Singulator 200 for the subsequent nuclei extraction. (Singulator 100 System, Tissue dissociation, S2 Genomics, 100‑067‑764; Singulator 200 System, Tissue dissociation, S2 Genomics)

steps.title: Load curls into NIC+ cartridge
steps.instruction: When the Singulator 100 reaches temperature, insert a pre‑cooled NIC+ cartridge, place the flattened curl inside, re‑attach the grinder head, and manually press and spin the grinder head a few times to flatten the curls on the cartridge bottom.

steps.title: Deparaffination and rehydration
steps.instruction: Start the run; deparaffination and rehydration proceed for 28 min (00:28:00). Upon completion, remove the cartridge from the machine.

steps.title: Prepare nuclei isolation reagent
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL nuclei isolation reagent (NIR; S2 Genomics) and 62.5 µL RNase Inhibitor (Merck MilliporeSigma, Catalog #3335402001) to achieve a final RNase inhibitor concentration of 0.2 U/µL (12.5 µL) up to 1 U/µL (62.5 µL).

steps.title: Transfer tissue to NIC+ cartridge
steps.instruction: Using forceps, transfer the tissue pieces into the NIC+ cartridge and add the 500 µL NIR with RNase inhibitor. Alternatively, remove the sample with a serological pipette, place it in a 5 mL Protein LoBind tube, centrifuge at 1000 × g, 4 °C for 3 min, discard supernatant, resuspend in 500 µL NIR plus 62.5 µL RNase inhibitor, then add the suspension to the cold NIC+ cartridge.

steps.title: Prepare nuclei storage reagent
steps.instruction: While the Singulator 200 is running, prepare 1 mL nuclei storage reagent (NSR; S2 Genomics) containing 1 U/µL RNase inhibitor by adding 25 µL RNase inhibitor to 1 mL NSR.

steps.title: Fixation and permeabilization
steps.instruction: Place the NIC+ cartridge in the Singulator 200, start the 10x Genomics GEM‑X Flex Sample Preparation v2 Kit (PN‑1000781) protocol (based on CG000782 rev D); run time is 18 min (00:18:00).

steps.title: Collect nuclei post‑run
steps.instruction: After the run, remove the cartridge and transfer the ~2 mL sample into a 5 mL Protein LoBind tube, centrifuge at 500 × g, 4 °C for 5 min, discard supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in 1 mL NSR with RNase inhibitor.

steps.title: Filter nuclei suspension
steps.instruction: Pass the suspension through a 30 µm pre‑separation filter (Miltenyi Biotec, cat 130‑041‑407) into a new 1.5 mL Protein LoBind tube, then centrifuge at 500 × g, 4 °C for 5 min.

steps.title: Incubate fixation
steps.instruction: Incubate the nuclei for 1 h at room temperature or 16–24 h at 4 °C; overnight fixation is recommended for long‑term storage (up to 12 months).

steps.title: Resuspend in Fixation Buffer B
steps.instruction: Resuspend nuclei in 500 µL room‑temperature Fixation Buffer B and pipette mix 5×.

steps.title: Remove supernatant and count
steps.instruction: Remove supernatant (up to 30 µL may remain if ≥50 000 nuclei); count nuclei using DAPI or AO/PI and note debris level.

steps.title: Add Additive C
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL room‑temperature Additive C (10x Genomics PN‑PN2001332) to the nuclei suspension and pipette mix 5×.

steps.title: Centrifuge and add Quenching Buffer
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 850 × g, room temperature, 5 min; add 1 mL chilled Quenching Buffer B, pipette mix 5×, and keep on ice.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Remove supernatant (up to 30 µL may remain if ≥50 000 nuclei).

steps.title: Long‑term storage preparation
steps.instruction: Add 0.1 volume pre‑warmed Enhancer (10x Genomics PN‑2000482) and add glycerol to a final concentration of 10 % (i.e., add 50 % glycerol); store at –80 °C for up to 12 months.

steps.title: Thaw nuclei
steps.instruction: Thaw nuclei according to the 10x Genomics protocol CG000782 rev D.

steps.title: Resuspend for sorting
steps.instruction: Resuspend nuclei in 500 µL Sorting & Collection buffer; set aside 5–10 % of the sample as a negative control.

steps.title: Centrifuge before staining
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 850 × g, 4 °C for 5 min and discard supernatant.

steps.title: Stain nuclei
steps.instruction: For DAPI staining, add 2.5 µL 200× DAPI stock to 500 µL sample. For SYTO9 staining, prepare intermediate stock (1 µL 5 mM SYTO9 + 1 mL PBS) and working solution (100 µL intermediate + 900 µL PBS); centrifuge nuclei at 500 × g, 4 °C for 5 min, discard supernatant, resuspend in 1 mL SYTO9 working solution, incubate 20 min at room temperature, then wash once with 500 µL Sorting & Collection buffer.

steps.title: Decrosslinking washes
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 850 × g, 4 °C for 5 min, discard supernatant, resuspend in 500 µL PBS‑T; repeat wash, then centrifuge again and resuspend in 500 µL Quenching Buffer B.

steps.title: Heat decrosslinking
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample on a thermoblock with heated lid: 80 °C for 30 min, then 22 °C for 10 min. Alternatively, the same incubation can be performed in PCR tubes using a thermal cycler.

steps.title: Resuspend in decrosslinking buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the sample in 500 µL decrosslinking buffer and pipette mix 5×.

steps.title: Prepare decrosslinking buffer
steps.instruction: Make 500 µL decrosslinking buffer containing 463 µL 162 nM 2‑amino‑5‑methylbenzoic acid in PBS (final 150 nM), 31.25 µL 8 M urea (final 0.5 M), and 6.25 µL 40 µg/mL Proteinase K (final 0.5 µg/mL).

steps.title: Filter before sorting
steps.instruction: Filter cells/nuclei through a 35 µm filter into a Falcon™ Test Tube with Cell Strainer Snap Cap (Corning cat 352235).

steps.title: Post‑sorting wash
steps.instruction: After sorting, centrifuge at 850 × g, 4 °C for 5 min, discard supernatant, and resuspend in 500 µL Sorting & Collection buffer.

steps.title: Prepare Fixation Buffer B
steps.instruction: Prepare 500 µL Fixation Buffer B at room temperature: 1× Fix & Perm Buffer B (10x Genomics PN‑2001301), 4 % formaldehyde, and nuclease‑free water to volume.

steps.title: Prepare Quenching Buffer B
steps.instruction: Prepare 1 mL Quenching Buffer B at 4 °C: 1× Quench Buffer B (10x Genomics PN‑2001300) and nuclease‑free water to volume.

steps.title: Proceed to FACS sorting
steps.instruction: Proceed to nuclei sorting by FACS; samples may be stored long‑term and processed after one freeze‑thaw cycle. It is recommended to collect all samples up to this point, sort them together, and continue with the 10x Genomics Flex assay. The next stopping point is an overnight Probe Hybridization during step 1 “Probe Hybridization” of the 10x GEM‑X Flex Gene Expression protocol.
